messages.subject: Project Lyra — mutual NDA for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Ahead of substantive discussions on the Veridian/Marrick licence (we're calling it Project Lyra), please find our mutual NDA attached. It's on standard terms — two-year term, three-year tail, trade secrets protected for so long as they remain secret. If content, please arrange signature at your end and we'll do the same.

James Osei
Senior Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
